rule: Typed receivers (decision A, all statically typed languages and typed PHP/Groovy declarations): a receiver whose type is given by a declaration — local, parameter, field/property (including `$var->prop` / `obj.field` chains whose property has a declared type), catch parameter, for-loop variable, pattern binding — or by `= new T(...)` gives `T#m` (high if defined in the scan, else medium).
source: KNOWN_GAP: receivers bound by match/if-let patterns, turbofish calls and user Deref impls are under-typed (match/if-let part)
notes: Layout: src/ (the scan root) holds a Cargo package, Cargo.toml plus src/*.rs, so module paths are crate-relative. w is bound by the pattern Msg::Job(w) against msg: Msg, whose variant Job is declared `Job(Worker)` → w: Worker. n is bound by Some(n) against next: Option<Worker> → n: Worker. Both are pattern bindings whose type comes from scanned declarations → Worker#run, high; w.run / n.run low guesses are wrong. Patterns and Msg::Stop / None are data, not calls. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (including path calls Type::assoc()) and direct for free functions, module-path functions and named nested functions.
